newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $656 mln for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $656 mln for Tuesday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Tuesday, May 20 are expected to total $656 million in 31 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $56 million in five sales, with a $24 million Missouri Environmental Improvement deal through Painewebber Inc. is topping the list.
On the competitive side, 26 sales totaling $600 million are on the schedule. A $285 million Nevada issue at 1030 EDT is the largest.
An additional six sales totaling $124 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Tuesday depending on market conditions.
